items.requirement: Define the exact production responsibility of Data plane.
items.evidence: Binding responsibility in contract.py and README.md.

items.requirement: Document what Data plane owns and explicitly does not own.
items.evidence: Owns/not_owns are explicit in contract.py and README.md.

items.requirement: Identify upstream, downstream, and peer dependencies of Data plane.
items.evidence: Adjacent GAP/PLN/INV dependencies are enumerated in contract.py.

items.requirement: Define the authoritative source of truth used by Data plane.
items.evidence: Residency policy is named as authoritative; locality is advisory.

items.requirement: Document assumptions Data plane makes about nodes, runtimes, networks, storage, and control planes.
items.evidence: Runtime/network/storage/control-plane assumptions are documented in contract.py.

items.requirement: Define tenant, environment, site, and workload boundaries relevant to Data plane.
items.evidence: Tenant/environment/site/workload boundaries are declared in contract.py.

items.requirement: Separate mandatory Data plane capabilities from optional optimizations.
items.evidence: Mandatory and optional capabilities are separated in contract.py.

items.requirement: Document unsupported deployment patterns and non-goals for Data plane.
items.evidence: Non-goals are explicit in contract.py/README.md.

items.requirement: Assign an accountable owner and escalation path for Data plane.
items.evidence: OWNERSHIP.json, docs/OWNERSHIP.md, .github/CODEOWNERS, RACI and fail-closed gate check implemented; named holders are vacant/proposed.

items.requirement: Approve an architecture decision record for Data plane, its technologies (Source-derived architectural plane), and its function (In-process Component Model calls, wRPC across nodes, vsock for VM control, shared memory/RDMA for large data.).
items.evidence: ADR-0002 selects and pins 4.3 technologies with rejected alternatives; approval table unsigned.

items.requirement: Translate the source function of Data plane — In-process Component Model calls, wRPC across nodes, vsock for VM control, shared memory/RDMA for large data. — into testable SHALL-level requirements.
items.evidence: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md FR-01..FR-08 are SHALL requirements each mapped to an executing test.

items.requirement: Define functional requirements for Data plane across cloud, datacenter, near-edge, and far-edge contexts where applicable.
items.evidence: config.DEPLOYMENT_CONTEXTS + docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §2 (cloud/datacenter/near/far edge); ConfigTest.

items.requirement: Define non-functional requirements for latency, availability, durability, consistency, isolation, or determinism as applicable.
items.evidence: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §7 defines availability/durability/consistency/isolation/determinism and p50/p95/p99/worst thresholds with measured baseline; thresholds await owner approval.

items.requirement: Define success, partial success, degraded operation, retryable failure, and terminal failure semantics for Data plane.
items.evidence: lifecycle.OUTCOMES + structured retryable errors; docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §3; JournalTest.

items.requirement: Define lifecycle states and legal state transitions managed or exposed by Data plane.
items.evidence: lifecycle.TRANSITIONS state machine with WAL journal, replay, illegal-transition rejection; JournalTest.

items.requirement: Define versioning and backward-compatibility requirements for Data plane.
items.evidence: docs/VERSIONING.md policy; schema $id versioning checked by ContractTest.

items.requirement: Define capacity ceilings, quotas, and fairness semantics relevant to Data plane.
items.evidence: Global/per-tenant ceilings + DRR FairScheduler with starvation bound; FairnessTest.

items.requirement: Define behavior when network connectivity is intermittent or absent.
items.evidence: Offline/intermittent semantics per context (max policy age, store-and-forward, fail closed); PolicyClient degraded-mode test.

items.requirement: Define precedence rules when Data plane requirements conflict with security, residency, SLO, or cost constraints.
items.evidence: precedence.PRECEDENCE evaluated on the submit path; PrecedenceTest proves ordering.

items.requirement: Maintain a requirements traceability matrix from each Data plane requirement to implementation and verification evidence.
items.evidence: TRACEABILITY.md maps all 100 requirements to repository evidence and residual gaps.

items.requirement: Enumerate every API, WIT contract, RPC, event, file, device, hypervisor, or control-plane boundary exposed by Data plane.
items.evidence: docs/VERSIONING.md surface table enumerates APIs, schemas, SPI, component interface, RPC, adjacent protocols, files (journal/audit/config).

items.requirement: Use versioned typed schemas for all externally visible Data plane contracts.
items.evidence: JSON Schema 2020-12 artifacts exist for PK_TRANSFER/1, PK_RESIDENCY/1, PK_TRANSPORT_TIER/1, metrics and health.

items.requirement: Define authentication requirements at each Data plane boundary.
items.evidence: security.Authenticator (workload/node/peer/operator/control_plane/provider kinds), mutual peer auth in pk06-rpc, mTLS; AuthenticationTest, NetworkRpcTest.

items.requirement: Define authorization and explicit capability requirements at each Data plane boundary.
items.evidence: security.CAPABILITIES deny-by-default with tenant scoping enforced at submit/cancel/policy/control/diagnostics; AuthorizationTest + service tests.

items.requirement: Define timeout, cancellation, retry, idempotency, and backpressure semantics for Data plane.
items.evidence: resilience.RetryPolicy/call_with_retry (deadline, per-attempt timeout, full jitter, cancellation), idempotent completion; RetryTest.

items.requirement: Define structured failure codes and machine-readable error details for Data plane.
items.evidence: Runtime errors carry stable machine-readable codes, retryability, and details through as_dict().

items.requirement: Define compatibility behavior when peers use different supported versions.
items.evidence: Version negotiation with refusal of unknown versions implemented and tested; N/N-1 skew not yet exercised (single protocol version exists).

items.requirement: Document payload, concurrency, queue, connection, or resource limits at Data plane interfaces.
items.evidence: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §6 lists payload/frame/queue/connection/buffer limits; enforced in code and tests.

items.requirement: Provide reference examples and conformance fixtures for Data plane.
items.evidence: README contains a reference example and tests provide executable fixtures for the dependency-free API.

items.requirement: Create automated integration tests proving Data plane interoperates with adjacent architectural layers.
items.evidence: Integration suite runs GAP-13/GAP-14/PLN-03/INV-36/INV-37 contracts against in-repo reference fixtures; real services not bound.

items.requirement: Select and pin approved implementations, versions, or specifications for Data plane: Source-derived architectural plane.
items.evidence: Selections pinned in ADR-0002 (pk06-rpc/1, component interface 1.0.0, TLS>=1.2); upstream wRPC/wasmtime/RDMA not pinned.

items.requirement: Separate immutable artifacts from mutable configuration and state for Data plane.
items.evidence: Immutable package (pyproject) vs mutable /var/lib/pln06 state and config/ overlays; docs/RUNBOOKS.md Day 0.

items.requirement: Define declarative configuration and secure defaults for Data plane.
items.evidence: config.SECURE_DEFAULTS + schema pk_config_v1 + validation; security floor outside dev; ConfigTest.

items.requirement: Validate configuration before activation and fail closed on security-critical errors.
items.evidence: Residency, limits, locality, identifiers and digest metadata are validated before activation/use and security-critical failures fail closed.

items.requirement: Support site- and environment-specific configuration without rebuilding immutable artifacts.
items.evidence: Environment overlays (config/overlays/*.json) applied without rebuild; ConfigTest.

items.requirement: Record configuration provenance, version, author, and activation time.
items.evidence: Active configuration records revision, author, and UTC activation time; decisions bind to config_revision.

items.requirement: Apply atomic or transactional configuration updates where partial application is unsafe.
items.evidence: replace_residency() validates a full candidate and swaps atomically while refusing changes that invalidate live transfers.

items.requirement: Define automatic and operator-driven rollback for failed Data plane changes.
items.evidence: config.ConfigController durable history, canary auto-rollback, operator rollback, emergency disable; ConfigTest.

items.requirement: Keep credentials and secret material out of ordinary Data plane configuration and diagnostics.
items.evidence: The runtime accepts no credential/key material and documents key custody as out of scope; diagnostics contain no secrets by design.

items.requirement: Provide a deterministic bootstrap path from an empty node/environment to healthy Data plane operation.
items.evidence: Deterministic Day-0 bootstrap in docs/RUNBOOKS.md; restart reconciliation in GovernedDataPlane._recover (DisasterRecoveryTest).

items.requirement: Threat-model Data plane against malicious tenants, compromised workloads, hostile inputs, supply-chain compromise, and control-plane abuse.
items.evidence: docs/THREAT_MODEL.md STRIDE matrix with test mapping; independent security review not recorded.

items.requirement: Apply least privilege to every identity and capability used by Data plane.
items.evidence: Least-privilege capability sets per principal kind; transport.use.<tier> checked per decision; adapter Grants.

items.requirement: Eliminate ambient filesystem, network, device, kernel, and secret authority wherever Data plane permits.
items.evidence: AuthorityGuard enforces per-adapter Grants in-process; OS-level seccomp/landlock/container profile not shipped.

items.requirement: Authenticate nodes, peers, artifacts, providers, and control-plane actors before trust is granted.
items.evidence: Nodes/peers (mutual HMAC + mTLS), policy/gravity documents (signed), control-plane operators (credentials) authenticated before trust; artifacts via SHA256SUMS.

items.requirement: Verify signatures, digests, provenance, and approved versions for executable or policy artifacts consumed by Data plane.
items.evidence: Signed labels, signed policy, payload manifests and SHA256SUMS verified; release signing is checksum/HMAC, not Sigstore.

items.requirement: Enforce tenant/workload isolation across Data plane execution, memory, state, network, and device boundaries as applicable.
items.evidence: Tenant-scoped auth, per-tenant quotas, namespaced shm, cross-tenant label refusal; hostile-tenant process isolation is a deployment control.

items.requirement: Encrypt sensitive Data plane data in transit and at rest with managed key rotation.
items.evidence: mTLS in transit implemented/tested; key rotation/revocation implemented; KMS/HSM custody and at-rest volume encryption pending.

items.requirement: Define safe behavior when identity, attestation, policy, key, or time services are unavailable.
items.evidence: Key/label/policy/journal outages fail closed; lifecycle.DEGRADED_MODES; tests for key outage and stale policy.

items.requirement: Emit tamper-evident audit events for security-sensitive Data plane operations.
items.evidence: security.AuditLedger hash-chained, MAC-sealed, fsync'd; all admissions/refusals/controls/policy events audited; AuditLedgerTest.

items.requirement: Run adversarial tests for privilege escalation, injection, replay, spoofing, escape, side channels, and resource exhaustion.
items.evidence: Adversarial tests for escalation, replay, spoofing, downgrade, tamper, escape, DoS mapped to threat IDs.

items.requirement: Enumerate component, process, VM, node, site, network, provider, dependency, and control-plane failures affecting Data plane.
items.evidence: resilience.FAILURE_MODEL catalog (process/VM/node/site/provider/control-plane/partition/stall/integrity/key).

items.requirement: Define automated health and stall detection thresholds for Data plane.
items.evidence: StallDetector + reap_stalled + backlog-age metric/alert; health readiness thresholds.

items.requirement: Implement bounded retry with backoff and jitter only where operations are safe to retry.
items.evidence: Bounded retry with exponential backoff + full jitter only for retryable classes; RetryTest.

items.requirement: Implement admission control, load shedding, or circuit breaking to prevent Data plane failure cascades.
items.evidence: Global and optional per-tenant non-inline admission limits provide bounded load shedding/backpressure.

items.requirement: Define failover behavior without violating isolation, residency, or consistency requirements.
items.evidence: FailoverController never weakens residency/isolation; wired into submit; partition failover test.

items.requirement: Provide degraded operation when noncritical dependencies are unavailable.
items.evidence: Degraded mode: last verified policy up to max age; inline continues when bulk down; telemetry loss non-blocking.

items.requirement: Define crash-consistency, restart, resume, or replay semantics for mutable Data plane state.
items.evidence: WAL journal replay, torn-tail tolerance, restart reconciliation to expired; JournalTest + DisasterRecoveryTest.

items.requirement: Protect against split-brain, duplicate ownership, stale controllers, or duplicate execution where relevant.
items.evidence: Fencing epoch lease blocks stale controllers (tested); lease is file-backed, fleet coordination pending.

items.requirement: Provide quarantine, freeze, disable, or isolation controls for unsafe Data plane behavior.
items.evidence: freeze/unfreeze/quarantine(destination|transport)/drain/emergency_disable, audited and capability-gated; test_operator_controls.

items.requirement: Run fault-injection tests proving Data plane recovery against documented objectives.
items.evidence: FaultInjector (seeded) + injected failures across key service, policy, transport, runtime hand-off, partition, crash; recovery asserted.

items.requirement: Establish reproducible baselines for Data plane latency, throughput, startup, CPU, memory, storage, network, and power overhead.
items.evidence: bench/perf.py baseline (latency, throughput, startup, CPU, RSS, shm/network) retained in bench/baseline.json.

items.requirement: Define p50, p95, p99, and worst-case performance thresholds for Data plane.
items.evidence: p50/p95/p99/worst thresholds defined and gate-enforced ceilings; pending owner approval.

items.requirement: Measure Data plane under steady load, burst load, overload, scale-out, scale-in, and recovery.
items.evidence: Steady/burst/overload/concurrency sweep measured; multi-node scale-out/in not measured.

items.requirement: Measure per-workload and per-tenant overhead introduced by Data plane.
items.evidence: Per-tenant quota/fairness overhead covered by tests; per-workload overhead measured only for the governed inline path.

items.requirement: Identify avoidable serialization, copies, context switches, network hops, duplicated images, or duplicated state in Data plane.
items.evidence: bench/perf.py efficiency_profile: copies/serializations/hops/context switches per adapter.

items.requirement: Apply locality, caching, direct composition, batching, zero-copy, or kernel-bypass optimizations where semantics permit.
items.evidence: Zero-copy in-process hand-off, shm, chunk batching implemented; RDMA/kernel-bypass not shipped.

items.requirement: Bound memory growth, queue depth, buffer size, concurrency, and resource fan-out.
items.evidence: Non-inline concurrency is bounded; there is no unbounded queue, and open-transfer bookkeeping is capped by the configured limits.

items.requirement: Measure power and thermal impact on constrained edge nodes where relevant.
items.evidence: Harness collects RAPL/thermal where exposed; no constrained-edge hardware measurement.

items.requirement: Define capacity models and saturation signals that predict when Data plane needs more resources.
items.evidence: USL capacity model from concurrency sweep with saturation signal (backpressure, saturation panel/alert); TD-001 records lock-contention finding.

items.requirement: Block releases that regress approved Data plane startup, density, throughput, or tail-latency thresholds.
items.evidence: bench/perf.py gate with regression budgets + absolute SLO ceilings, wired into CI perf-gate job.

items.requirement: Expose Data plane health, readiness, version, configuration, dependency status, and active capability set.
items.evidence: GovernedDataPlane.health (PK_DATA_PLANE_HEALTH/2) reports version, config, dependency status, degraded list, lineage.

items.requirement: Emit structured metrics for rate, errors, latency, saturation, backlog, and resource use.
items.evidence: MetricsRegistry counters/gauges/histograms + Prometheus exporter incl. latency, backlog age, CPU/RSS.

items.requirement: Emit structured logs with stable node, tenant, workload, component, and operation identifiers.
items.evidence: StructuredLogger PK_LOG/1 with stable IDs, redaction, bounded ring, sink failure tolerance; schema-validated.

items.requirement: Propagate trace context across all relevant Data plane boundaries.
items.evidence: W3C traceparent ingress/egress propagation across submit and failover; LoggingTracingTest.

items.requirement: Expose high-cardinality diagnostic detail safely without leaking tenant or secret data.
items.evidence: Explain view hashes tenant/workload, redacts secrets, capability-gated; metric cardinality cap.

items.requirement: Record the reason for every automated decision made by Data plane.
items.evidence: Every admission decision includes a stable operator-readable reason plus config revision and selected tier/locality.

items.requirement: Provide an operator-readable explain view linking decisions to input state, policies, topology, and constraints.
items.evidence: explain() links decision to policy revision, constraint precedence, adapter choice and fallbacks, lineage.

items.requirement: Correlate Data plane events with application release lineage and the live infrastructure graph.
items.evidence: lineage block (release, artifact SHA-256, node, infra_graph_ref) on health/explain/logs; live infrastructure graph not connected.

items.requirement: Define telemetry retention, sampling, privacy, and export policy.
items.evidence: observability.TELEMETRY_POLICY + docs/TELEMETRY_GOVERNANCE.md.

items.requirement: Create dashboards and alerts distinguishing ordinary load, degradation, policy rejection, dependency failure, attack, and software defect.
items.evidence: ops/alerts (6 classes) and ops/dashboards checked in and validated against emitted series; not deployed.

items.requirement: Create unit tests for deterministic Data plane logic and state transitions.
items.evidence: Dependency-free unittest coverage exercises deterministic tiering, validation, state transitions, quotas, configuration and metrics.

items.requirement: Create contract tests for every public Data plane interface.
items.evidence: Every emitted object validated against its schema; mutation-rejection and error-code uniqueness tests.

items.requirement: Create integration tests with every supported adjacent layer and execution tier.
items.evidence: All execution tiers and adapters tested; adjacent layers via reference fixtures.

items.requirement: Create compatibility tests across supported CPU architectures, runtimes, hypervisors, providers, and protocol versions relevant to Data plane.
items.evidence: CI matrix defined (py3.10-3.13 x86_64/arm64); executed here on one platform only.

items.requirement: Fuzz parsers, schemas, protocol handlers, WIT/RPC boundaries, or untrusted inputs handled by Data plane.
items.evidence: Seeded fuzz of admit, residency config, completion records, config overlays, manifests, RPC frame parser.

items.requirement: Create concurrency and race-condition tests for shared/distributed Data plane state.
items.evidence: A multi-threaded 64-attempt admission race verifies the configured global limit is never oversubscribed.

items.requirement: Create security tests derived directly from the Data plane threat model.
items.evidence: Security tests derived from THREAT_MODEL IDs (test names cited in the matrix).

items.requirement: Create benchmark, soak, burst, and fleet-scale tests appropriate to Data plane.
items.evidence: Benchmark, burst concurrency and bounded-state soak run in CI; multi-hour/fleet runs scheduled only.

items.requirement: Create disaster, partition, reconnect, and degraded-control-plane tests.
items.evidence: Partition failover, reconnect after refused peer, degraded control plane (stale policy), replay, crash-restart and backup/restore tests.

items.requirement: Require machine-readable acceptance evidence before certifying a Data plane release for production.
items.evidence: tools/evidence.py + tools/release_gate.py produce machine-readable, checksummed dossier and gate result; pk_core gate not runnable.

items.requirement: Define production SLOs, error budgets, and support commitments for Data plane.
items.evidence: SLO 99.9 %, error budget and support commitments defined; awaiting owner approval.

items.evidence: Canary/staged rollout, rollback and emergency disable implemented (ConfigController, service controls) and in RUNBOOKS.

items.evidence: Compatibility matrix structure in COMPATIBILITY.md; only one row executed.

items.evidence: docs/VULNERABILITY_POLICY.md SLAs, CVE triage and EOL dates.

items.evidence: docs/RUNBOOKS.md day-0/1/2 with capabilities; procedures exercised by service tests.

items.evidence: Severity/paging/escalation/containment/recovery defined; contacts vacant.

items.evidence: docs/REVIEWS.md cadence + template + gate staleness check; no review has been performed yet.
